nina: Quick sync 1: Legal flagged per-tenant debug/inspect UI — they want clear rules on what can appear in the console and what consumes quota. Can we agree on a small, testable policy?

ashok: tl;dr: console = metadata by default. Payload capture requires explicit approval + budget. Three principles: minimize raw PII, per-tenant isolation, immutable audit trail.

jordan: Proposal sketch: sampling states = (standard, elevated, inspect). Standard/elevated follow current telemetry sampler. Inspect is a separate "inspect_credits" pool per tenant that gates payload capture/playback. Credits are consumed per inspected request (weight depends on sensitivity).

nina: UX needs: show remaining credits (%) and recent inspect events (approver, ttl, approval_id). Red flag when <10% with one-click request to owner. Also hide raw payload unless approver + legal_hold.

ashok: For identifiers: use HMAC with per-tenant salt + version tag. Never store raw IDs in logs. Rotation: quarterly rotate salts, only re-hash incoming events.

jordan: Example envelope (metadata-first, no raw ids):
```json
{"env":"inspect.v1","tenant":"t-7f2","sample_reason":"inspect:manual","fingerprint":"hmac-v1:af3b...","sensitivity":"medium","summary":"truncated resp text"}
```

sre-zoe: Ops runbook notes: alerts at 15% (warn), 5% (escalate), 0% (auto-fallback). On 0% we fallback to metadata-only and block payload capture. Owners + oncall get notif. Emergency override allowed but must: 1) write immutable audit entry with approver and justification, 2) mark event as emergency and consume credits, 3) auto-email compliance.

nina: Rate-limits: playback / manual inspect rate-limit = 3 reqs/min per-tenant, burst up to 8 for 10s. We can tune numbers in canary.

ashok: Sensitivity mapping: route-level config with allowed capture: chat->medium (truncate+hash), embeddings->high (no raw text persisted; store embedding_id + fingerprint), attachments->high (disabled by default).

jordan: Retention: default TTL for inspect payloads = 30d, auto-delete after TTL unless legal_hold tag present. Provide legal-hold API that marks entries and prevents deletion.

compliance-bot: NOTE: beta rollout window scheduled 2024-10-02 01:00 UTC for 3 tenants; compliance will monitor.

nina: Action items: 1) ashok -> formalize HMAC + rotation RFC, 2) jordan -> envelope schema + credit accounting model + sample weights, 3) sre-zoe -> runbook + alert thresholds + emergency flow. Put behind feature flag `inspect_payload_v1` for initial test.

ashok: Also include a developer flow: no raw data in console; if dev needs raw payload for debugging they must open a request with approver + SRE export (logged).

jordan: I'll draft RFC and wireframes, link here when ready.

compliance-bot: RFC watchlist set: compliance@redwood. RFC link required for rollout approval.

jordan: RFC posted: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/r/inspect-credits-and-envelopes-v1 -- ping for feedback.
